kit-elements.html:
Elements

9 in the registry.

avatar element A person, as initials.
button element The primary action. Quiet and danger are variants.
checkbox element A checkbox. Checked is a variant.
icon element One glyph from the sprite. Pass name= (home, board, list, …).
input element A text field.
link element A text link.
pill element Task status. Default is todo.
sprite element The icon sprite — every glyph, hidden, inlined by the layouts.
tag element A small count or label.
